dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Miss Noogie, a sweet girl who loves being part of whatever her people are doing!

Miss Noogie loves spending time with people, whether she’s heading out for a walk, hopping in the car for a ride or settling in for some snuggles. Bring out a squeaky toy and she’s happy to make time for a little fun, too! Miss Noogie also has an adorable morning routine: rolling onto her back for a good scratch. Add some attention and a tasty treat, and you’ve found the way to her big heart. Looking for a companion to share the everyday moments with? Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Miss Noogie’s team in Pawling, New York. Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Miss Noogie’s team in Pawling, New York.

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
